The reported artifact is the previous circle remaining at its last cursor position after Ripple is selected.

inferences: The symptom may involve transient drawing state during settings application, but the current evidence does not establish whether Mouse Highlighter was active, a button was held, or settings were changed while a visual was fading.
issue_context.analysis: The unanswered sequence is decision-changing because current code clears and restarts drawing during ApplySettings, and later main changes altered event/reset handling. A second dashboard request would be redundant while the existing author-feedback request is pending.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete body, single comment, labels, and timeline; no linked fix or duplicate exists.
Inspected MouseHighlighter.cpp ApplySettings, StartDrawing, StopDrawing, ClearDrawing, and ResetPendingMouseInput paths.
